items.body_raw: וַתַּהַר וַתֵּרֶא כִּי הָרָתָה וַתֵּקַל גְּבִרְתָּהּ בְּעֵינֶיהָ
items.answer_raw: And she conceived; and when she saw that she had conceived, her mistress was despised in her eyes.

items.body_raw: הִתְהַלֵּךְ לְפָנַי וֶהְיֵה תָמִים וַהֲקִמֹתִי אֶת־בְּרִיתִי לִהְיוֹת לְךָ לֵאלֹהִים
items.answer_raw: Walk before me and be perfect, and I will establish my covenant to be thy God.

items.body_raw: וַיָּסַר נֹחַ אֶת־מִכְסֵה הַתֵּבָה וַיַּרְא וְהִנֵּה חָרְבוּ פְּנֵי הָאֲדָמָה
items.answer_raw: And Noah removed the covering of the ark; and he looked, and behold, the face of the ground was dry.

items.body_raw: וַיִּטַּע נֹחַ כֶּרֶם וַיֵּשְׁתְּ מִן־הַיַּיִן וַיִּשְׁכָּר וַיִּתְגַּל בְּתוֹךְ אָהֳלֹה
items.answer_raw: And Noah planted a vineyard, and he drank of the wine and was drunken; and he uncovered himself within his tent.

items.body_raw: וַיֶּחֱלֶא הַמֶּלֶךְ בְּרַגְלָיו וְגַם־בְּחָלְיוֹ לֹא דָרַשׁ אֶת־יהוה
items.answer_raw: And the king was diseased in his feet, yet in his disease he sought not Yahweh.
Stretch forth thy hand and cause frogs to come up.

items.body_raw: וַיְהִי רִיב בֵּין רֹעֵי מִקְנֵה אַבְרָם וּבֵין רֹעֵי מִקְנֵה לוֹט וַיֹּאמְרוּ אִישׁ אֶל־רֵעֵהוּ אַל־נָא תְהִי מְרִיבָה בֵּינִי וּבֵינֶךָ
items.answer_raw: And there was strife between the herdsmen of Abram's cattle and the herdsmen of Lot's cattle; and they said to one another, Let there be no strife, I pray thee, between me and thee.

items.body_raw: וַיֵּרָא יהוה אֶל־אַבְרָם וַיִּבֶן שָׁם אַבְרָם מִזְבֵּחַ לַיהוָה הַנִּרְאֶה אֵלָיו
items.answer_raw: And Yahweh appeared to Abram, and Abram built there an altar to Yahweh who had appeared to him.
Let the name of Yahweh be blessed.

items.body_raw: ויראו השמרים איש יוצא מן־העיר ויאמרו לו הראנו נא את־מבוא העיר ועשינו עמך חסד ויראם את־מבוא העיר ויכו את־העיר לפי־חרב ואת־האיש שלחו וילך האיש ארץ החתים ויבן עיר ויקרא שמה לוז הוא שמה עד היום הזה
items.answer_raw: And the watchers saw a man coming out of the city, and they said to him, Show us, we pray thee, the entrance to the city, and we will deal with thee kindly. And he showed them the entrance to the city, and they smote the city with the edge of the sword; but the man they let go. And the man went to the land of the Hittites; and he built a city, and called the name of it Luz; that is its name to this day.

items.body_raw: And Noah did according to all that Yahweh commanded him.
And he commanded the priests, saying, Come up out of the Jordan; and they went up.
items.answer_raw: וַיְצַו אֶת־הַכֹּהֲנִים לֵאמֹר עֲלוּ מִן־הַיַּרְדֵּן וַיַּעֲלוּ

items.body_raw: And the man of God stretched out his hand and brought up the frogs, and Pharaoh saw the plagues, and he feared (with) a great fear.
items.answer_raw: וַיֵּט אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים אֶת־יָדוֹ וַיַּעַל אֶת־הַצְפַרְדְּעִים וַיַּרְא פַרְעֹה אֶת־הַמַּכּוֹת וַיִּירָא יִרְאָה גְדוֹלָה

items.body_raw: And it came to pass, when they were in the field, that the man rose up against (אל) his friend and slew him.
items.answer_raw: וַיְהִי בִּהְיוֹתָם בַּשָּׂדֶה וַיָּקָם הָאִישׁ אֶל־רֵעֵהוּ וַיַּהַרְגֵהוּ

items.body_raw: Let the waters be gathered together unto one place, and let the dry land appear; and it was so.
items.answer_raw: יִקָּווּ הַמַּיִם אֶל־מָקוֹם אֶחָד וְתֵרָאֶה הַיַּבָּשָׁה וַיְהִי־כֵן

items.body_raw: And God opened her eyes and she saw a well of water, and she went and filled the bottle with-water, and made the boy drink.
items.answer_raw: וַיִּפְקַח אֱלֹהִים אֶת־עֵינֶיהָ וַתֵּרֶא בְּאֵר מַיִם וַתֵּלֶךְ וַתְּמַלֵּא אֶת־הַחֵמֶת מַיִם וַתַּשְׁקְ אֶת־הַנָּעַר

items.body_raw: And the captain of the host said, Who (ever) shall smite Qiryath Sēpher and take it, then (waw cons.) I will give him my daughter to wife.
items.answer_raw: וַיֹּאמֶר שַׂר הַצָּבָא אֲשֶׁר־יַכֶּה אֶת־קִרְיַת־סֵפֶר וּלְכָדָהּ וְנָתַתִּי לוֹ אֶת־בִּתִּי לְאִשָּׁה

items.body_raw: Bow (נטה, Hiph.) thy heavens and come down.
